description: School kilometric bus routes - Queensland is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. As part of the School Transport Assistance Scheme (STAS), TMR approves the designated routes for bus operators to transport students to and from school. The School Kilometric Bus Route dataset depicts these routes. There are many different operators and routes throughout the State. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are STAS, school bus, school routes, school transport. It offers 2 resource(s) in shp, tab, fgdb, kmz, gpkg, xml. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
